outcome.answer: Several supplied papers address transformer recommender popularity bias. [1] studies scaling transformer-based sequential recommenders and finds that larger models can amplify popularity bias; it proposes SPRINT to reduce this effect and improve long-tail fairness. [8] also targets a Transformer-based next-item recommender and says noncontrastive self-supervised learning can mitigate popularity bias while improving long-tail coverage. [3] addresses sequential recommendation with a loss-only method that reduces popularity bias without architectural changes, but it is not specifically about transformers.
